name: stylecraft-inventory-management
description: Windows desktop inventory management software for StyleCraft.
author: StyleCraft

scripts.dev:electron: set VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173&& wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native:electron && electron-builder --dir --config.npmRebuild=false && npm run verify:package:native && npm run rebuild:native:node
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native:electron && electron-builder --win nsis --config.npmRebuild=false && npm run verify:package:native && npm run rebuild:native:node
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native:electron && node scripts/ensure-github-release.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis --config.npmRebuild=false --publish always && npm run verify:package:native && npm run rebuild:native:node
scripts.test: npm run test:electron && npm run test:renderer && npm run test:db
scripts.test:db: vitest run db/schema.test.ts db/upgrade.test.ts db/client.test.ts db/paths.test.ts db/verify.test.ts db/products-service.test.ts db/product-variants-service.test.ts db/contacts-service.test.ts db/audit-service.test.ts db/stock-adjustments-service.test.ts db/returns-service.test.ts db/purchases-service.test.ts db/sales-service.test.ts db/dashboard-service.test.ts db/reports-service.test.ts db/invoices-service.test.ts db/backup-service.test.ts db/settings-service.test.ts db/ledger-service.test.ts db/sale-edit-service.test.ts
